description: Land Title Settlement Department - Pussella, Rideegama D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No. 420089
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels (Parcel No. 205 and 242) with detailed land ownership information, including parcel numbers, extents, owner names, addresses, and title classifications. The content falls under "Land and property-related matters" including "land registrations, property ownership, land titles" as specified in Type 4 classification.
